Feature: Lab Request and Consultation Management

  Scenario: Lab requests are routed to the Laboratory after matching the Patient Pincode
    Given a patient with Pincode "12345"
    When a lab request is submitted with Pincode "12345"
    Then the request should be routed to the Laboratory

  Scenario Outline: Lab personnel make appointments and perform home collection of specimen
    Given lab personnel are available
    When they make an appointment for a patient with Pincode "<pincode>"
    Then the appointment should be scheduled and specimen collection should be arranged

    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 12345   |
      | 67890   |
      | invalid |

  Scenario: Lab personnel email or send reports to Patients directly
    Given lab personnel have completed a test for a patient with Pincode "12345"
    When they generate a report
    Then the report should be emailed or sent directly to the patient

  Scenario Outline: Patients upload reports up to 5 reports (up to 1 MB size) per Consultation
    Given a patient with Pincode "12345" is in a consultation
    When they upload a report of size "<size>"
    Then the upload should be "<result>"

    Examples:
      | size    | result  |
      | 0.5 MB  | success |
      | 1 MB    | success |
      | 1.1 MB  | failure |
      | 5 files | success |
      | 6 files | failure |

  Scenario: Each Patient Consultation request is routed to 1 Doctor of a Speciality
    Given a patient with Pincode "12345" requests a consultation
    When the request is processed
    Then the request should be routed to 1 Doctor of a Speciality

  Scenario: Machine Learning Algorithm predicts diseases based on Symptoms
    Given a patient with Pincode "12345" has symptoms "fever, cough"
    When the symptoms are input into the Machine Learning Algorithm
    Then the algorithm should predict a disease

  Scenario: Doctors can accept or modify the diagnosis
    Given a doctor receives a diagnosis from the Machine Learning Algorithm
    When they review the diagnosis
    Then they should be able to accept or modify the diagnosis

  Scenario: The responsibility is with Doctor to perform Diagnosis
    Given a patient with Pincode "12345" has a consultation
    When the doctor reviews the patient's symptoms
    Then the doctor should be responsible for performing the diagnosis
